subject: math
name: Mathematics
title: Kindergarten Mathematics: Foundations of Counting & Geometry
overview: Kindergarten mathematics develops foundational number sense, geometric reasoning, and spatial awareness through manipulative investigations, problem-solving routines, and structured discussions.
competencies: Demonstrate deep conceptual understanding of Kindergarten number systems and operations.
Identify, describe, and analyze two-dimensional and three-dimensional geometric figures.
Apply measurement tools and strategies to quantify length, weight, and volume.
Solve real-world story problems using visual models, drawings, and mathematical notation.

modules.title: Numbers to 10: Two-Dimensional and Three-Dimensional Shapes
modules.description: Classifying objects, counting quantities up to 10, connecting numerals to quantities, and identifying basic 2D and 3D geometric shapes.

topics.title: Attributes of Two Related Objects
topics.description: Classifying and categorizing objects by color, size, and function.

topics.title: Classify to Find Two Groups and Count
topics.description: Counting objects up to 5 and writing numerals.

topics.title: Numerals to 5 in Different Configurations
topics.description: Counting in rows, arrays, circles, and scattered sets.

topics.title: The Concept of Zero and Numbers to 10
topics.description: Understanding zero as none, counting forward and backward within 10.

modules.title: Comparison of Length, Weight, Capacity, and Numbers to 10
modules.description: Direct measurement comparisons (longer, shorter, heavier, lighter) and numerical comparisons (greater than, less than).

topics.title: Comparison of Length and Height
topics.description: Comparing lengths directly with connecting cubes and classroom objects.

topics.title: Comparison of Weight and Capacity
topics.description: Balancing scales and measuring liquid volume using standard cups.

topics.title: Comparing Numbers to 10
topics.description: Using matching strategies to determine which group has more or fewer items.

modules.title: Number Pairs, Addition and Subtraction to 10
modules.description: Decomposing numbers into pairs, introducing plus, minus, and equal signs, and solving word problems within 10.

topics.title: Composing and Decomposing Numbers to 5
topics.description: Using number bonds and counters to explore part-whole relationships.

topics.title: Addition Stories and Facts to 10
topics.description: Modeling joining scenarios with manipulatives and writing number sentences.

topics.title: Subtraction Stories and Facts to 10
topics.description: Modeling taking-away situations and writing subtraction equations.

modules.title: Numbers 10 to 20 and Counting to 100
modules.description: Understanding teen numbers as a group of ten and some ones, and counting to 100 by ones and tens.

topics.title: Teen Numbers as 10 and Some Ones
topics.description: Building numbers 11 to 19 with ten-frames and place value blocks.

topics.title: Counting to 100 by Ones and Tens
topics.description: Rote counting to 100, recognizing patterns on the hundred chart.
